title: aspidium squamigerum
intro: Aspidium squamigerum, commonly known as the scaly maidenhair fern, is a species of fern in the family Aspleniaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its various health benefits, which include the reduction of inflammation and the enhancement of immune function. The therapeutic actions of A. squamigerum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential in treating conditions such as arthritis and wounds. The bioactive constituents of A. squamigerum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
